title: How to See How Many Calls and Visits Your Google Business Profile Brings
description: Tutorial to open the Performance report of your Google Business Profile and see how many people call, ask for directions or visit your website. Official sources.

answer.question: How do I see how many calls and visits my Google Business Profile gets?
answer.text: At business.google.com click "Performance", choose the period and click "Apply"; on mobile, in the Google Maps app, tap "Business" and "See more" next to "Performance".

intro: Many businesses have a Google listing and do not know whether it brings them customers. The Business Profile Performance report answers that with Google's own data: how many people see you, call you, ask for directions or visit your website.

body.text: According to the official help, only the metrics that apply to your business appear, and data only exists for verified profiles. Views count unique visitors, at most once a day per person. The searches metric is updated at the beginning of each month and can take up to 5 days to show.
Do not be surprised to see low figures at first: what matters is the trend. If you upload photos, reply to reviews and publish updates, check every month whether calls and directions grow.

items: There is data only if your listing is verified
It shows searches, views, calls, directions and clicks to your website
Only the metrics that apply to your business appear
The searches metric is updated at the beginning of the month
Sign in with your listing's account. You must use the Google account associated with the Business Profile, and the profile must be verified.
On a computer. Go to business.google.com, click "Performance", choose the report period at the top and click "Apply".
On mobile. In the Google Maps app tap "Business" (bottom right), tap "See more" next to "Performance", choose the period and tap "Apply".

Interpret the metrics. Depending on your business you will see: searches that found you, views on Search and Maps, directions, calls (if you have added your phone number), clicks to your website and messages.
Compare periods. Define a date range and compare it with the previous one to see whether your changes (photos, posts, reviews) move the figures.
Check that your listing is verified and that you have added your phone number
Write down today's figures for calls, directions and website clicks as a starting point
Review the report on the 5th of each month, when searches have already been updated

faq.q: Why do I see no data in the Performance report?
faq.a: Data only exists for verified profiles, and only the metrics that apply to your business appear. Check that your listing is verified.

faq.q: When is the searches metric updated?
faq.a: At the beginning of each month, and it can take up to 5 days to show, according to the official help.

faq.q: Do views count every time someone sees my listing?
faq.a: No. They count unique visitors, at most once a day per person.
